'''Maniid''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] who made regular shipments to [[Bracha e'Naso]] at [[Esau's Ridge]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tholatin]].
